title: Chicken Delicious
description: This incredibly delicious chicken is baked in the slow cooker in a super simple sauce of condensed soups, mushrooms, Parmesan, and sherry.
ingredients: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of celery soup

steps.text: Mix condensed soups and sherry together in a medium bowl.
Season chicken with lemon juice, paprika, celery salt, salt, and pepper; place into a slow cooker. Pour soup mixture over chicken, then sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.

Cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, on Low for 8 to 10 hours or High for 4 to 5 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: Watch how in a matter of minutes you can put together a slow cooker meal using a few staple kitchen ingredients. Seasoned chicken breast halves are slowly cooked in a creamy sauce made from cream of mushroom and cream of celery soup. We'll add a bit of dry sherry to the sauce to elevate this dish and give it a deeper, richer flavor.
